variantDrops.label: Variant drops
variantDrops.description: Epic and Legendary items from random chests, enemy remains and bosses can drop as variants with different enhancements. Turning it off only stops new drops; variants you own keep working. On a server, the server's switch decides.

craftedEquipmentRarity.label: Crafted equipment rarity by level
craftedEquipmentRarity.description: Crafted armor, shields and weapons get their rarity from their item level (up to 5 Common, 10 Uncommon, 15 Rare, above that Epic), and their cost changes by 25% per rarity step. Items crafted earlier keep their rarity.

variantMarker.label: Mark variants with §
variantMarker.description: Shows "§" before variant names, e.g. "§ Scorching Wand". Only changes what you see in your own game.

allowUntestedGameVersions.label: Allow on untested game versions
allowUntestedGameVersions.description: At your own risk. After a game update, the mod finds the game functions it needs by itself instead of waiting for a mod update. It uses them only if every check passes, but it can't prove the game still behaves the same. When off, variant drops and the § stop on untested versions until the mod is updated.

craftedLoreItems.label: Crafted lore items
craftedLoreItems.description: Crafted copies of lore items become Legendary (cost +50%) at the item level of their tier's crafted armor. Items crafted earlier keep their rarity.
